čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person'
büleġei: bü- — to be; -leġei past: 'there was, used to be' (a variant of -leġe; Ming 來) [有來]
haran-i: haran — people, subjects, commoners (noun) + accusative -i 'the people' (noun + case; Ming 人 + 行) [人行]
alažuγ̇ui: ala- — to kill; past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'killed' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [殺︀了]
žürukin-e: Žürukin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name; a spelling of Žürkin); dative-locative -e, 'to the Jurkin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [種名 行]
kigdebe: ki- — to do, make; passive -gde-, past -be, 'was done, was made' (verb, passive past) [做了]
keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126)
ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's
ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
kigden: ki- — to do, make; passive -gde-; converb -n, 'being done' (verb, passive converb) [被做]
bida: bida — we, us (inclusive: you and I; first-person plural pronoun, Ming 咱) [咱]
onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
tün-dür: tün — forest (noun; stem not otherwise known, 'forest' is the Ming's); dative-locative -dür, 'in' (case, front-vowel form) [林裏]
dur: -dur — dative-locative: at, in (case suffix, back-vowel form; the token left after a hyphen; Ming 時 'time', 'at the time of') [時]
baγ̇urči: baγ̇urči — cook, steward of the food (Ming 厨子) (noun) [厨子]
šikiγ̇ur-i: Šikiγ̇ur — Shikiur, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Shikiur' as object (personal name + case) [人名 行]
belgütei-jin: Belgütei — Belgütei, the younger brother of Chinggis (Ming 太祖弟名); genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [太祖︀弟名 的]
mürü: mürü — shoulder, shoulder-blade (noun; Ming 肩甲) [肩甲]
žokilduja: žoki- — to be fitting, agree (stem inferred from the Ming 和); -ldu- reciprocal, 'one another'; hortative -ja, 'let us …' (verb, hortative, first person plural; Ming 商和咱) [商和咱]
keġegdežü: keġe- — to say; passive -gde-; converb -žü, 'being told' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被說着]
qorižin: Qorižin — Qorijin, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
qatun: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a khan (noun) [娘子]
quγ̇určin: Quγ̇určin — Qughurchin, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
žirin-i: žirin — two (of persons; Ming 兩箇); accusative -i, 'the two (object)' (numeral + case) [兩箇行]
ičuγ̇ažu: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred); causative -uγ̇a-; converb -žu, 'sending back' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [退着]
ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
teġün-ü: teġün-ü — of that, his, her (tere, stem teġün- before case endings, + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [那的]
erten-ü: erten — former time, long ago; genitive -ü, 'of former times, former' (noun + case) [在先的]
öšiten: öši — grudge, feud (read from the Ming 讐); possessive plural -ten, 'those having a feud, feuding' (noun + possessive plural; Ming 讐有的(每)) [讐有的(每)]
ebüges: ebüge — grandfather, forefather (read from the Ming 祖宗); plural -s, 'forefathers' (noun + plural) [祖︀宗]
ečiges-i: ečige — father (noun); plural -s, 'fathers'; accusative -i, 'the fathers' as object (noun + plural + case; Ming 父親(每)行) [父親(每)行]
baraγsad: bara- — to be finished, ruined; past participle plural -γsad, 'those who have been ruined' (verb, participle, plural) [廢盡了的(每)]
tatar-i: Tatar — the Tatars; accusative -i, 'the Tatars' as object (name + case; Ming 種名行) [(種名行)]
qamsan: qamsa- — to join, combine (stem inferred from the Ming 併); converb -n, 'joining' (verb, converb) [併]
morilaja: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; hortative -ja, 'let us mount' (noun-derived verb, hortative, first person plural) [上馬咱]
žürkin-i: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name); accusative -i, 'the Jurkin' as object (name + case; Ming 人名 行) [人名 行]
žirγoγ̇an: Žirγoγ̇an — Jirqo'an, a man's name (personal name; the numeral 'six' as a name) [人名] · also written without a capital as the plain numeral žirγoγ̇an, 'six' (Ming 六), in žirγoγ̇an üdüd, 'six days'
külčežü: külče- — to wait; -žü: converb: -ing (front-vowel form) [等着]
šiqan: šiqa- — to lean against, keep close to (stem inferred; Ming 挨); -n: converb: -ing [挨着]
keġeġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb) [說了]
morilaba: morila- — to mount a horse (from morin 'horse'); past -ba, 'mounted' (verb, past tense) [上馬了]
kelüren-ü: Kelüren — the Kelüren, a river (Ming 河名); genitive -ü, 'of the Kelüren' (river name + case, front-vowel form) [河名 的]
büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]
irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的]
daγ̇uliba: daγ̇uli- — to plunder, to seize (Ming 據 'seize'); past -ba, 'seized' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [據了]
sača-beki: Sača-Beki — Sacha-Beki, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
taiču: Taiču — Taichu, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
bejesi: beje — body, person (noun); plural -s (Ming 每; uncertain), the (i) before the reflexive-possessive -jen being Shiratori's; so 'one's own persons' (noun + plural, reading from the Ming gloss and the context) [身子(每)自的行]
jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own') · also after čerig(i)- ('one's own troops') and eje-dür(i)- ('in one's own counsel', eje uncertain), the token left being jen
dutaγ̇aba: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, run away; past -ba, 'fled' (verb, past tense) [走了]
qoināča: qoina — behind, after; ablative -ča (short form of -ača), 'from behind' (noun + case) [後自]
an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
nekežü: neke- — to pursue, chase (stem inferred from the Ming 追趕); converb -žü, 'pursuing' (verb, converb) [追趕著︀] · also 'attacking' (Ming 襲着 'attack'; stem uncertain)
amasar-a: amasar — mouth, entrance; dative -a, 'at the mouth' (noun + dative-locative, back-vowel form) [口子 行]
qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
bariba: bari- — to take hold of, to grasp; past -ba, 'took hold of' (verb, past; Ming 拿了也) [拿了也]
barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
qojar-a: qojar — two, the pair; dative -a, 'by the two' (numeral + case; here the agent after a passive) [兩箇 行] · also 'to the two' (Ming 兩箇行), the addressees of an order, in aqa qojar-a ügüle
erte: erte — early, in former times (adjective, adverb) [自在]
keġeldüleġei: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + past -leġei, 'have said' (Ming 來; verb, reciprocal past; the ending's force is uncertain) [共說來麽]
ügülegsen: ügüle- — to speak, to say; past participle -gsen, 'spoken' (verb, participle) [說了的]
üge-düri: üge — word, speech; dative-locative -dür, 'in the word'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [言語 自的行]
ba: ba — and, both (conjunction) [并] · also 'we', first-person plural pronoun (Ming 俺, against bida 咱), standing at the head of its clause or after the verb · also 'also, even' after a word (Ming 也), as in ger-tür(i)-jen ba ülü odun
ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
kürbe: kür- — to reach, arrive; past -be, 'reached' (verb, past tense) [到了]
man-u: man-u — our, of us (ba, genitive stem man- + -u, the possessor stands before or after its noun) [俺的]
üges-i: üge — word, speech; plural -s + accusative -i, 'the words' as object (noun + plural + case) [言語每(行)]
kürgen: kürge- — to bring to, to deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -n, 'bringing' (verb, converb) [送到]
mün: mün — just, the very, indeed (particle; Ming 是 'is', elsewhere 只那 'that same') [是]
tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
qarižu: qari- — to turn back, return; converb -žu, 'turning back' (verb, converb) [囘著︀]
irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊]
žalair-un: Žalair — the Jalair, a people; -un: genitive: of (back-vowel form) [種名的]
köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
čin-u: či — you; genitive -u on the oblique stem čin-, 'your' (pronoun + case) [你的]
boltuγai: bol- — to become, be; optative -tuγai, 'let it be, may it be' (verb, optative) [可]
bulžiγ̇asu: bulžiγ- — to dodge, to slip away, to wriggle (Ming 躱閃); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if one dodges' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [躱閃呵]
nü: -(n)ü — genitive: of (front-vowel form) [的] · also printed after an n-final stem (Tumbinai-Sečen-(n)ü) and after back-vowel names (Qabul-Qaγan-(n)ü), where the front-vowel form breaks harmony; the Ming 訥 writes -nu and -nü alike
neče: -(n)eče — ablative: than, from (front-vowel form; the token left after Temüžin-(n)eče, where the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 處) (case suffix) [(兒名)處]
köġüdi: köġüd(i) — sons; the (i) is read as the accusative -i (the Ming marks 行) before the reflexive -(i)jen (köġün + plural -d) [子每(自的)行] · also köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons' (Ming 兒子(每)自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jer, as in tümed(i)-jer, not the accusative
qaγan-dur: qaγan — qan, sovereign, emperor; dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
altan: altan — gold (noun); a man's name, as a son's name (Altan); and in Altan Qaγan the title of the Jin emperor, where the Ming glosses 金 'gold, Jin' (noun, personal name, title) [(兒)名; 金]
sakižu: saki- — to guard, keep watch; converb -žu, 'guarding' (verb, converb) [守着]
atuγai: a- — to be, remain; optative -tuγai, 'let it be, let it stay' (verb, optative, third person) [存着]
bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
aṅgida: aṅgida — apart, besides, outside (adverb or postposition; Ming 外) [外]
ergüžü: ergü- — to lift up (stem inferred; Ming 擡); -žü converb: -ing (front-vowel form) [擡着]
ögtügei: ög- — to give; optative -tügei, 'let him give, let it be given' (verb, optative, third person, front-vowel form) [與者︀]
keġebe: keġe- — to say; past -be, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
qasar-a: Qasar — Qasar, a man's name; dative-locative -a, 'to Qasar' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
žurkin-u: Žurkin — the Jurkin, a clan name (clan name; Ming 種名); -u genitive: of (back-vowel form) [種名的]
nutuγ-ača: nutuγ — camp, pasture-ground (Ming 營盤); -ača: ablative: from (back-vowel form) [營盤 行]
neretü: nere — name; possessive -tü, 'having a name, named' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [名字有的]
üčüken: üčüken — small, little (adjective; Ming 小) [小]
köġüken-i: köġü — son, child (noun); diminutive -ken, 'little son, small child' (Ming 小兒); accusative -i, 'the little child (object)' (noun + diminutive + case) [(小兒)行]
abčiražü: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [將(來)着]
höġelün: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
eke-de: eke — mother; dative -de, 'to the mother' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [母 行]
merkid-ün: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; genitive -ün after a consonant (name + case) [種名(的)]
küčü: küčü — strength, power (noun; Ming 氣力) · also Küčü, a boy's name (Ming 人名) [氣力]
taičiγ̇ud-un: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan; genitive -un, 'of the Taichi'ud' (name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [種名的]
besüd-ün: Besüd — the Besüd, a people; -ün: genitive: of (front-vowel form) [種名 的]
kököčü: Kököčü — Kököchü, a boy's name (personal name) [人名]
tatar-un: Tatar — the Tatars, a people; genitive -un, 'of the Tatars' (name + case; Ming (種名)的) [(種名)的]
ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
težiġerün: težiġe- — to rear, bring up; -rün 'while …-ing', 'while rearing' (verb, time-converb) [養時]
köġüd-teġen: köġüd-teġen — own sons (köġün + plural -d + reflexive-possessive plural -teġen; here 'her own') [子(每) 自的(行)]
üžekü-jin: üže- — to see; participle -kü + genitive -jin, 'of the seeing, of what is seen' (verb, participle + case) [見 的]
sonosqu-jin: sonos- — to hear, to listen; participle -qu + genitive -jin, 'of the hearing, of what is heard' (verb, participle + case) [聽 的]
ken-e: ken-e — by or to whoever (ken 'who' + dative-locative -e, front-vowel form) [任誰] · also interrogative, 'to whom?, by whom?' (Ming 誰行), where the entry's 'whoever' does not fit (ken-e boldaqu-ju bi, 'to whom am I made ...?')
težiġebe: težiġe- — to rear, bring up, feed; past -be, 'reared' (verb, past tense) [養了]
irgen-ü: irgen — people; genitive -ü after n, 'of the people' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [百姓的]
josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
qabul: Qabul — Qabul, a man's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
qān-u: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan); genitive -u, 'of the Qan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝的]
köġüd-ün: köġün — son; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the sons' (noun + plural + case) [兒子的]
aṅqa: aṅqa — first, foremost (adjective; Ming 最 'most') [最]
büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
dotorāča: dotor — inside, interior (noun); ablative -āča, 'from inside' (the long vowel runs the stem vowel into -ača) [裏處]
aman: aman — mouth, muzzle (noun) [口] · also 'oath, vow' (Ming 盟 'covenant'), compare aman aldaž- 'to swear'
ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
tula: tula — because of, on account of (postposition; the Ming 上頭 'on top of', hence 'for that reason') [上頭]
teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
irgen-i: irgen — people; accusative -i, 'the people (object)' (noun + case) [百姓 行]
ulus-i: ulus — people, realm; accusative -i, 'the people (object)' (noun + case) [百姓行]
öġer-ün: öġer — own, self; genitive -ün after r (pronoun + case) [自己(的)]
bolγaba: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + past -ba, 'made into, treated as' (verb, causative past) [做了]
